topic.readerProblem: Work out what Profound actually does today, how hard it is to set up and run, and whether it is worth buying, without a hands-on review.
topic.connection: Helps an AEOeye reader decide between an enterprise monitoring platform, cheaper trackers and a one-off AI visibility audit.

assessment: The page rewrites the old Profound review and folds in the 'is Profound too complicated' answer. It rests entirely on Profound's own pricing page, feature pages, help-center articles, developer docs and university page, fetched 2026-10-03, plus SparkToro's study for the daily-repeat rationale and AEOeye's vendor-site crawl. It corrects stale claims (no trial, Starter/Growth cards, 1-3 weeks to data, G2 score) and does not claim hands-on use, quote review scores it could not load, or estimate an Enterprise price.

sources.supports: Homepage positioning as an AI marketing platform with an AI Marketer that finds work, drafts it and asks for approval.

Free 7-day Trial (50 prompts daily, ChatGPT/Gemini/Google AI Overviews, fixed prompt set), quote-only Enterprise (up to 9 engines, API, exports, SSO), credits FAQ, 'Is Profound only for AI search? No', setup 'Instant'.
Tracker features (visibility, sentiment, citations, FactCheck), browser capture rather than API, daily runs because AI platforms don't return the same answer twice.
Definitions of visibility score, share of voice, average position, sentiment, citations and FactCheck.
Prompt-set setup: 5-10 topics to start, about 15 topics with about 10 prompts each, metrics populate after 24-48 hours, initial 'No Data' is normal.
Agent Analytics needs hosting-provider access and a provider-specific log integration (Cloudflare, Vercel, CloudFront, Fastly and others).
Client-rendered pages may look empty to AI assistants; rendering does not guarantee inclusion or citation in an answer.
Profound 101 course (272 min, beginner) and two-week pod ending in certification.
Under 1-in-100 chance that ChatGPT or Google's AI gives the same brand list in two responses; repeated runs needed.
GEO is also known as answer engine optimization (AEO): improving visibility in AI-generated responses.
